data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 11.2m (2022: favourable development of GBP 3.9m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 7.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, accepted reinsurance of GBP 3.6m and releases of GBP 0.9m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 0.3m in Other direct.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows a gross release on prior years of approximately GBP 39.5m (5.0% of opening gross claims outstanding) based on the gross claims development table. The movement note reports a net favourable development of GBP 11.2m net of reinsurance; the net outcome reflects releases in Third Party Liability, accepted reinsurance and Aviation, partially offset by a small strengthening in Other direct. The primary drivers are favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 11.2m (2022: favourable development of GBP 3.9m); this is mainly comprised of releases of GBP 7.0m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, accepted reinsurance of GBP 3.6m and releases of GBP 0.9m in respect of Aviation business, partially offset by strengthening of GBP 0.3m in Other direct.
This level of Management Adjustment is considered appropriate in light of the uncertainties surrounding the current economic environment, loss exposure on opioids and other pharma losses.

Throughout 2023 we have built upon our inflation analysis, which supports the explicit uplift that we have included within our net best estimate reserves to reflect the current heightened economic inflationary environment and broader uncertainty in the UK and worldwide economy.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) because the explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' note gives only a net (after reinsurance) figure (GBP 11.2m). Gross PYD computed by diagonal comparison of the triangle = -GBP 39.494m (release). Triangle numbers are reported in GBP '000 in the report and were converted to millions here. 'Other direct' movement was mapped to 'Property' for LOB mapping (report uses 'Other direct').
